Sie befinden sind hier: Startseite > Börse > Nebenwerte > Fibra Macquarie stock faces delisting after acquisition ...

Fibra Macquarie stock faces a BMV delisting after its acquisition by Fibra Mty on September 22, 2026. The transaction changes its trading outlook.

Fibra Macquarie stock is facing a change in its trading status after Fibra Mty confirmed plans to cancel the company's registration and quotation on the Bolsa Mexicana de Valores following the acquisition reported on September 22, 2026. The development gives investors a concrete corporate-action issue rather than a routine earnings update.

Acquisition changes the listing outlook

According to Milenio on September 22, 2026, Fibra Mty completed the purchase of Fibra Macquarie and intends to cancel Fibra Macquarie's presence and quotation on the Mexican exchange. The report identifies the planned delisting as a next step in the integration of the acquired trust.

The relevant comparison is structural: before the transaction, Fibra Macquarie was a separately quoted listed vehicle; after the acquisition, the reported plan is to remove that quotation. The change affects liquidity, trading access and the way investors assess any remaining listed exposure.

Trading status is the key variable

Fibra Macquarie has an important operating date in September 2026 because the acquisition was reported as completed by September 22, 2026. The same report links the proposed cancellation of the BMV registration to Fibra Mty's post-acquisition plans, making the transaction the clearest dated fact available for the shares.

For investors, the practical distinction is between the completed acquisition and the subsequent administrative process. Completion is dated September 22, 2026, while the cancellation of the registration and quotation is described as a future plan. That distinction matters because a planned delisting is not the same as a confirmed final trading date.

Stock status follows the corporate action

Fibra Macquarie stock therefore carries a corporate-action focus as of September 23, 2026. The acquisition date of September 22, 2026 and the reported plan to cancel the BMV quotation are the two concrete reference points for evaluating the security's trading outlook.

Trading venue: Bolsa Mexicana de Valores
